extractedRequirements.title: Design Real-Time Ad-Tech Bidding Engine
extractedRequirements.description: Develop a robust and scalable real-time ad-tech bidding engine to serve ultra-low latency needs for target users with the ability to handle high traffic volumes, especially during sudden spikes.
non_functional_requirements: High Scalability to handle sudden spikes in traffic
Ability to process at least 100,000 requests per second under high load conditions

database.justification: Handles horizontal scaling and writes efficiently, making it suitable for handling a data volume of 10,000 GB/month while also providing the necessary write throughput.

cache.justification: Offers ultra-low latency for frequent read operations and can handle a significant request rate, complemented by Memcached to avoid bottlenecks in case of Redis performance degradation.

messaging.justification: Enables real-time stream processing and efficient request handling through the use of distributed streaming, allowing for high concurrency without blocking operations under heavy load conditions.

deployment.choice: Serverless architecture using AWS Lambda with provisioned concurrency
deployment.justification: Ensures near-zero latency during spikes in traffic and automatic scaling down to save costs when idle. Providedconcurrency settings help maintain performance targets even under request rate of 100,000 req/s.

observability.choice: CloudWatch with AWS X-Ray for distributed tracing
observability.justification: Monitors all components and provides trace data across services to quickly identify issues under varying load conditions. This is crucial in a high-demand, real-time system.

security.choice: AWS KMS for encryption management with customer managed keys
security.justification: Meets compliance requirements while providing control over the cryptographic materials used to protect sensitive user information at rest and in transit, as required by GDPR and CCPA.

triggeredRules.justification: Single node capacity limits are reached at this scale.
Scales to zero to save costs during idle periods and scales instantly for spikes.
Reduces database I/O bottlenecks for frequent read operations.
Horizontal write scaling is significantly easier than sharding a massive RDBMS.
RDBMS LIKE queries do not scale for full-text indexing at volume.
Decouples services to prevent cascading failures under heavy load.
Legal requirement to protect sensitive user information at rest and in transit.
